+            transitions = sum((~n[k]) & n[k + 1] for k in range(1, 8)) + ((~n[8]) & n[1])
+            remove = n[0] & (neighbors >= 2) & (neighbors <= 6) & (transitions == 1)

+            else:

+def build_routes():
